storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature, away from moisture and sunlight.
looksLike: Tiny round seeds about 1 mm across, dark brown to black for the small 'rai' used in tadka; they pop when added to hot oil.
howToPick: Pick uniform, hard, round, shiny dark seeds with no dust, husk, stones or musty smell; seeds that are dull, broken or oily-smelling are old.
shelfLife: About 1 year or more in a sealed jar (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run). (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run)
substitutes: Hing or urad dal in the tempering

usedIn.raw: 1 g per serving (½ tsp, tempered in oil)
